title: Implement tasks completion checker script
description: Create scripts/check_tasks_completion.py to parse docs/TASKS_V10_OPTIMIZED.md checkboxes and output machine-readable completion metrics with optional strict exit mode.

criteria: Script returns total_checked, total_unchecked, completion_ratio and top pending items.
Script supports soft mode (always exit 0) and strict mode (exit non-zero when unchecked > 0).
Output format is stable for CI consumption (JSON + concise text summary).

files.change: Add new checker script with markdown checkbox parsing and CLI flags for strictness and target file.

implementation: Count '- [x]' and '- [ ]' tasks; capture first N unchecked lines as preview.
Emit JSON payload + one-line summary; support --strict and --output-json options.
test: Run script locally in soft mode and strict mode against docs/TASKS_V10_OPTIMIZED.md; verify counts and exit codes.
